name: app-dark-anime-figure-seat-selection-with-brush-notes
title: Dark Seat Selection with Anime Traveller
whatItIs: A dark slate slide with a torn white note 'Choose Your Perfect Seat', a dark phone showing an aircraft seat map with blue selected seats and a Confirm Seat button, an anime-style illustrated traveller in black holding a phone, a torn note 'How It Work?' and a tilted tablet peeking at the base.
whatItMeans: An illustrated character adds personality to a dark UI, and torn notes give an informal, crafted feel.
techniques: Torn white brush notes as headings
Dark UI with blue selected seats
Tilted tablet cropped at the bottom

vocabulary.definition: A diagram of seats a user can choose.
An illustrated person representing the user.
A rough painted shape holding text.
